Name: CS_RAYTRACING_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Ray tracing settings for each level of the Ray Tracing Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns ray tracing on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Ray-Traced Sun Shadows
Fields.Description: Lets the sun (directional light) use ray-traced shadows.

Fields.Name: Sun Shadow Ray Count Scale
Fields.Description: Sun shadow ray count = base count × Scale + Offset, rounded and clamped to 1–16. Retail: 0.5 Low, 0.75 Medium, 1 High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Sun Shadow Ray Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the scaled sun shadow ray count (see Sun Shadow Ray Count Scale). Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: AO Ray Count Scale
Fields.Description: Ambient occlusion ray count = base count × Scale + Offset, rounded and clamped to 1–32. Retail: 0.5 Low and Medium, 1 High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: AO Ray Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the scaled ambient occlusion ray count (see AO Ray Count Scale). Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Sun Shadow Cone Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the cone size of ray-traced sun shadows (shadow softness). 0 or less: a single shadow ray. Retail: 0.2 Low, 1 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distances at which ray tracing hands over to screen-space ambient occlusion and shadow maps. Retail: 0.8 Off and Low, 0.9 Medium, 1 High and Maximum.
